title: Analyst, Business Systems
description:
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
The IT Business Analyst for Sales plays a vital role in establishing and maintaining trusted partnerships with Corporate Sales/Commercial teams and technical stakeholders. This position is responsible for providing technical expertise throughout the selection, process and solution design, and deployment of global business solutions within designated application portfolios.
  
  
A core aspect of this role involves a comprehensive understanding of Sales/Commercial business processes and supporting technologies to facilitate functional requirements definition, including process design and information needs. The incumbent will support solution implementation from conception through development and transition to operational support teams.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Relationship Management with Business Functions:
  
  

* Provides global support and troubleshooting for applications supporting Sales/Commercial teams, such as Campfire, EDI, sales quoting tools, and SAP.
* Assists business partners in identifying new capabilities, offering thought leadership and innovation regarding emerging trends in global sales solutions.
* Contributes to achieving objectives outlined by Sales/Commercial and IT leadership within the strategic technology roadmap.

**Solution Functional Design**

* Defines and documents necessary solution requirements to deliver fully functional business processes and systems, clarifying scope of work.

* Manages and evaluates program risks, escalating recommendations for leadership review and business decision-making.

**Education And Qualifications**

* Recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Systems, or a related field, along with 1–2 years of relevant business domain and industry experience.
* Demonstrated functional business acumen in Sales/Commercial or Order to Cash disciplines.

description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
  
  
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
  
  
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Associate Industrial Engineer (P1)**
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an Associate Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This early-career role will support factory performance improvement initiatives across multiple wafer fabrication sites through capacity modeling, data analytics, reporting automation, cycle time reduction, and scheduling optimization. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross-site analytical tools and decision-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support development and maintenance of cross-site capacity models, factory loadings, and utilization analyses.
* Assist with cycle time improvement initiatives through bottleneck analysis, WIP management, and line balancing activities.
* Analyze factory performance data and identify opportunities to increase throughput, productivity, and equipment utilization.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
* Support validation of manufacturing scheduling data, forecasting models, and factory planning assumptions.
* Participate in scenario analysis and what-if modeling to evaluate capacity, output, and resource requirements.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Work Experience**

* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively within geographically distributed teams.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: AI annotation & Transcription Expert(Telugu)
description:
Telugu Document Annotation Specialist

**Role:**
Telugu Language Expert / Document Annotation Specialist

**Work Type:**
Remote Contract

**Language Requirement:**
Native Telugu and English

**Project:**
AI Training Data — Document Understanding

About the Role

We are looking for native Telugu speakers to help train and evaluate AI models on real-world Telugu documents. You will annotate PDF pages by identifying document structures, labeling text and visual elements, mapping reading order, and transcribing all text accurately in Telugu script.

The project focuses on complex documents, including newspapers, textbooks, examination papers, handwritten forms, tables, diagrams, and mixed-script layouts. Accuracy and attention to detail are essential.

Key Responsibilities

* Review assigned PDF pages for Telugu content, legibility, and suitability for annotation.
* Identify, classify, and mark document regions, including headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, figures, captions, formulas, questions, and answer fields.
* Assign accurate reading-order indices and link related elements using parent component identifiers.
* Transcribe printed and handwritten Telugu text faithfully in the original script.
* Maintain character-level accuracy, including diacritics, conjunct forms, punctuation, and numerals.
* Record page metadata, including language, document type, source, dimensions, and relevant content flags.
* Flag illegible, unsuitable, or sensitive pages according to project guidelines.
* Review and quality-check annotations completed by other Telugu annotators as needed.

Requirements

* Native or near-native Telugu proficiency with excellent command of Telugu script.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to transcription accuracy.
* Experience in transcription, proofreading, translation, localization, annotation, subtitling, journalism, or regional-language data review.
* Ability to interpret complex document layouts, including multi-column pages, tables, and handwritten content.
* Ability to follow detailed annotation guidelines and apply labeling standards consistently.
* Reliable internet access and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with AI training data, OCR correction, document annotation, or data labeling.
* Familiarity with Telugu Unicode, input methods, and script normalization.
* Experience in document digitization, typesetting, copy-editing, or language quality assurance.
* Experience reviewing annotations or performing linguistic quality checks.

What Success Looks Like

* Complete and accurate identification of all meaningful document regions.
* Correct component labels, boundaries, relationships, and reading order.
* Faithful Telugu transcription with minimal character-level errors.
* Consistent adherence to project guidelines and successful quality reviews.
* Early identification of unsuitable or illegible pages.
